title: K-LEAN Entry V3.4
description: Schema for Knowledge DB entries. Soft validation: warns on violations, does not block writes.

title.description: Short descriptive title naming the specific thing

insight.description: 2-4 sentences with specific details and grounding

related_to.description: IDs of related entries (shell-safe regex enforced)

depends_on.description: IDs of prerequisite entries (shell-safe regex enforced)

last_validated.description: ISO date of last validation or null

utility_score.description: Q-value tracking how often this entry led to successful outcomes. Updated via EMA: Q_new = Q_old + alpha * (reward - Q_old). Default null (unscored).

retrieval_count.description: Number of times this entry was retrieved for use in a session. Tracks usage frequency for staleness detection.

salience_score.description: Pre-storage salience score (0.0-1.0). Computed at capture time from 5 signals: specificity, novelty, actionability, groundedness, priority. SNARC-inspired: filter noise at capture, not retrieval.

last_retrieved.description: ISO datetime of last retrieval for use in a session. Enables time-based decay of entries that were used heavily in the past but not recently.

decision_type.description: Decision classification. Only set when type='decision'.

causal_chain.description: IDs of K-LEAN entries that led to this decision. Enables 'why did we decide X?' traversal.

supersedes.description: ID of entry this decision replaces. The superseded entry remains in the DB but is marked as evolved.

valid_until.description: ISO date when this decision should be re-evaluated. Consolidation script flags expired decisions.
